name: Cases
query:
SELECT
    u.full_name AS User_Full_Name,
    i.subject AS Subject,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'VM Support' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VM_Support,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Batch' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Batch,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Permissions' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Permissions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Shipping Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Shipping_Request,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Print Labels' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Print_Labels,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Wrap Ready' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Wrap_Ready,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Build Machine' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Build_Machine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Product Testing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Product_Testing,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Sales Support' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Sales_Support,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Salesforce' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Salesforce,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Issues' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Issues,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Tasks' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Tasks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Information' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Information,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Travel Install' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Travel_Install,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Virtual Install Call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Virtual_Install_Call,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Desktop Support' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Desktop_Support,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Client Call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Client_Call,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Redeployment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Redeployment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'New Deployment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS New_Deployment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Product Innovation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Product_Innovation,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Change Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Change_Request,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = '--None--' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS None,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Technical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Technical,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'PO Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PO_Request,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Equipment Issue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Equipment_Issue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Website' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Website,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Related to Existing Case' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Related_to_Existing_Case,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Reconfiguration' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Reconfiguration,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Other' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Other,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Miscellaneous Issues' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Miscellaneous_Issues,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Receivable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Receivable,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Remove Vend' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Remove_Vend,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Data Update' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Data_Update
FROM
    `tabIssue` i
JOIN
    `tabUser` u ON i.case_owner = u.email
WHERE
    YEAR(i.date_and_time_closed) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(i.date_and_time_closed) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND i.status = 'Closed'
    AND u.enabled = 1
GROUP BY
    u.full_name
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason IN ('Data Update', 'Equipment Issue', 'Miscellaneous Issues', 'Other', 'PO Request', 'Receivable', 'Reconfiguration', 'Related to Existing Case', 'Remove Vend', 'Technical', 'VM Support', 'Website') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;
